# term — the terminal emulator of the Code mode's terminal panel (docs/CODE-TERMINAL.md): the VT
# parser (parser.h), the screen model with its scrollback (screen.h, cell.h), the sequences' meaning
# and the replies to the program (terminal.h), the input encodings of keys, pastes and the mouse
# (keys.h), the column widths of code points (charwidth.h; charwidth_table_p.h is generated by
# scripts/term-width-table.py), the text of the scrollback as lines with a way back to cells and its
# search (screentext.h), and links in the output without OSC 8 — URLs, file paths with a line
# (links.h). GUI-free: the pseudo-terminal is src/platform/pty.h, the view src/app/terminal.
brulion_add_core_module(term
    SOURCES
        term.h
        cell.h
        charwidth.h charwidth.cpp charwidth_table_p.h
        parser.h parser.cpp
        screen.h screen.cpp
        terminal.h terminal.cpp
        keys.h keys.cpp
        screentext.h screentext.cpp
        links.h links.cpp)
